environment.description: Same service deployed in namespace 'logging' on Istio 1.19 mesh with STRICT mTLS. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied to the 'logging' namespace with a default-deny action (spec.action: DENY, spec.rules with source.namespaces not in ['logging']). However, the policy uses a 'when' condition matching on request.headers[x-forwarded-client-cert] containing URI field with SPIFFE ID prefix, and the DENY rule specifically targets source.namespaces: ['*'] with a notNamespaces exception for 'logging' itself. Note: the policy's selector matches workloads with label app=log-aggregator only, and the service mesh sidecar injection is confirmed via istio-injection=enabled label on namespace. PeerAuthentication in namespace sets mtls mode STRICT. A secondary ALLOW policy exists but only permits GET /health from istio-system namespace for probes.

config.notes: External traffic cannot bypass Envoy sidecar due to iptables rules injected by istio-init container. No privileged containers can modify iptables in this namespace per PSP.
